description: Agent Roles: submit the delegations of a role with what the written role lets be delegated: the role with its id, title, owner, the register where delegations must be recorded and each duty it names as delegable or kept back, with the most days and the largest amount and unit a delegate may hold; each delegation in effect with its id, the duty, the delegate, who made it, the amount and unit, when it starts and ends, who stays accountable and where it is recorded (the role register, a delegation record, a message or nowhere); and the date delegations are read at. The signed report gives the role’s delegation clause, every delegation with the clause it falls under, its length in days and whether it has lapsed, and counts the delegations within the role, those of a duty kept back, over the limit, with no end and unrecorded, and names unbounded delegation: a duty the role does not let be delegated, an amount past the role’s limit or no limit where the role sets one, no end date, a length past what the role allows, someone other than the role’s owner kept accountable and a delegation recorded only in a message or nowhere; then a record outside the register the role names, a delegation made by someone other than the owner, a lapsed delegation still listed and a limit in another unit, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No delegation clause, no owner, no delegations, or an unstated accountable person or record leaves the delegations unverified. This reads every delegation of one role against what the role allows: one delegation’s own written bounds are wever_delegation-scope-check, its expiry enforcement is wever_delegation-expiry-check, a system’s delegation records are wever_delegation-record-check and authority narrowing down a chain is wever_delegation-chain-check. Verdict role_delegation_unbounded, role_delegation_partial, role_delegation_unverified or role_delegation_bounded. POST /api/role-delegation-check. Reads the role records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Roles reads a role’s own records and checks the role itself: what the job is, who owns it, whether the permissions the agent holds match the written role, where its scope ends, whether a change of holder rewrote the description, whether it is reviewed on schedule, whether duties stay apart across the roles one agent holds, and whether delegations stay inside what the role allows. Beside it, wever_onboarding-permissions-check and wever_onboarding-readiness-check read a new agent’s grants and written job at joining, while a role check reads the written role and its records at any time after; wever_authority-scope-check reads one action’s access against its authority grant, while the permission match check reads every permission held against the role; and the Agent Delegation checks such as wever_delegation-scope-check read one delegation on its own terms, while the delegation check reads every delegation against what the role allows. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-roles-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-roles/.

delegations.description: Delegations of the role in effect.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

read_at.description: The date delegations are read at, such as 2026-11-20.

delegable.description: What the role lets be delegated, as written.
